evals.name: terse-output
evals.setup:
A long session in a writable checkout. `/go:style` was corrected twice — it rewrote a test as table-driven when only a style offense was flagged ("fix the offense in place, don't restructure tests I didn't ask you to touch"), and it reported offenses inside `vendor/` ("skip vendored and generated files, they're not ours to style") — and `/craft:cm` once ("stop reaching for `chore`; every commit has a real type"). None of the three is stated in the skill bodies. Both skill directories are writable, carry the `## Self-learning` block, and have no `LESSONS.md`.

The agent has already mined and proposed these: two rules for `go:style`, one for `craft:cm`. The user has just approved, so this is the write turn.
